fighter_champion.name: Champion
fighter_champion.description: A straightforward master of arms who trusts strength and staying power.

fighter_guardian.name: Guardian
fighter_guardian.description: A shield-first defender who outlasts the enemy line.

wizard_evoker.name: Evoker
wizard_evoker.description: A spellcaster who shapes raw elemental force into a weapon.

wizard_abjurer.name: Abjurer
wizard_abjurer.description: A careful caster who turns magic inward to hold the line.

rogue_assassin.name: Assassin
rogue_assassin.description: A killer who turns every opening into a killing stroke.

rogue_trickster.name: Trickster
rogue_trickster.description: A scoundrel who survives by being somewhere else when the blow lands.

cleric_warpriest.name: War Priest
cleric_warpriest.description: A militant vessel of the faith, armored in conviction.

cleric_oracle.name: Oracle
cleric_oracle.description: A seer who reads the shape of the battle before it closes.

sorcerer_draconic.name: Draconic Bloodline
sorcerer_draconic.description: Your magic runs hot and close beneath the skin.

sorcerer_wild.name: Wild Magic
sorcerer_wild.description: Your power refuses a fixed shape and spills out in storms.
